findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: literature_review_outline, pre_submission_review · Private data: dataset_columns, dataset_profile, list_my_data_files · Public sink: dunn_posthoc, linear_mixed_model, protein_ptm, tukey_hsd · Destructive: academic_polish, citation_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: literature_review_outline, pre_submission_review · Private data: dataset_columns, dataset_profile, list_my_data_files · Public sink: dunn_posthoc, linear_mixed_model, protein_ptm, tukey_hsd · Destructive: academic_polish, citation_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
